specs.t023: Tax is rounded once per rate over the invoice and spread over its lines (43c, 43c and 44c on three $3.33 lines at 13%)
specs.t036: A line refund is its net less its discount share plus its tax, so three identical lines refund identically ($3.76 each)

text: Tax follows the tax authority: rounded once per rate and spread over the lines (t023). A line refund returns that line's net, less its share of the discount, plus the tax actually charged on that line, so identical lines can differ by a cent (two refunds of $3.76 and one of $3.77 in the three-line example), and refunding every line still returns the invoice total.
